answer: In an agent market for ocean, terrace, and karst survey data, each seller must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before bidding, with only one live contract allowed per bond. A contract verifier burns the bond if the seller misses its agreed delivery deadline. Running 1,000 fake sellers therefore ties up $100,000, and abandoning their contracts forfeits it. New identities remain easy to create, but each additional contract requires real collateral.
